question: What is our total realised revenue in USD?
ref_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.revenue_usd)::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales f  WHERE f.is_realised

question: How much gross profit did completed orders generate?
ref_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.gross_profit_usd)::numeric, 2) AS gross_profit_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales f  WHERE f.is_realised

question: What is the overall gross margin percentage?
ref_sql: SELECT ROUND((100 * SUM(f.gross_profit_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(f.revenue_usd), 0))::numeric, 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM analytics.fact_sales f  WHERE f.is_realised

question: How many orders were completed?
ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_sales f  WHERE f.is_realised

question: What is the average order value of completed orders?
ref_sql: SELECT ROUND((SUM(f.revenue_usd) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id), 0))::numeric, 2) AS avg_order_value_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales f  WHERE f.is_realised

question: How many distinct customers have at least one completed order?
ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_id) AS customers FROM analytics.fact_sales f  WHERE f.is_realised

question: Show realised revenue for each month of the period.
ref_sql: SELECT d.year_month, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue_usd)::numeric, 2) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY d.year_month ORDER BY d.year_month

question: Rank the products by revenue.
ref_sql: SELECT p.product, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue_usd)::numeric, 2) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_product p ON p.product = f.product WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY p.product ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC

question: What is the gross margin percentage of each product?
ref_sql: SELECT p.product, ROUND((100 * SUM(f.gross_profit_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(f.revenue_usd), 0))::numeric, 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_product p ON p.product = f.product WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY p.product ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC
source: Metabase card: Gross margin % by product

question: For each product, give revenue, gross profit, units sold, gross margin % and its revenue rank.
ref_sql: SELECT p.product, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue_usd)::numeric, 2) AS revenue_usd, ROUND(SUM(f.gross_profit_usd)::numeric, 2) AS gross_profit_usd, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, ROUND((100 * SUM(f.gross_profit_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(f.revenue_usd), 0))::numeric, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(f.revenue_usd) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_product p ON p.product = f.product WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY p.product ORDER BY revenue_rank

question: How is revenue split across regions?
ref_sql: SELECT g.region, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue_usd)::numeric, 2) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_geography g ON g.country = f.country WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY g.region ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC

question: Revenue per country, highest first.
ref_sql: SELECT g.country, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue_usd)::numeric, 2) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_geography g ON g.country = f.country WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY g.country ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC

question: For every region and country, show revenue, number of orders, gross margin % and number of customers.
ref_sql: SELECT g.region, g.country, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue_usd)::numeric, 2) AS revenue_usd, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS orders, ROUND((100 * SUM(f.gross_profit_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(f.revenue_usd), 0))::numeric, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_id) AS customers FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_geography g ON g.country = f.country WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY g.region, g.country ORDER BY g.region, revenue_usd DESC
source: Metabase card: Region and country table

question: Give yearly revenue with the year-over-year growth in percent.
ref_sql: WITH yearly AS (SELECT d.year, SUM(f.revenue_usd) AS revenue FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY d.year) SELECT year, ROUND(revenue::numeric, 2) AS revenue_usd, ROUND((100 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year)) / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year), 0))::numeric, 2) AS revenue_yoy_pct FROM yearly ORDER BY year
source: Metabase card: Revenue by year and YoY

question: What is the average revenue of each calendar month (January to December) across all years?
ref_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT d.year, d.month, d.month_name, SUM(f.revenue_usd) AS revenue FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY d.year, d.month, d.month_name) SELECT month_name, ROUND(AVG(revenue)::numeric, 2) AS avg_revenue_usd FROM monthly GROUP BY month, month_name ORDER BY month
source: Metabase card: Revenue by month of year

question: What is the revenue by season?
ref_sql: SELECT d.season, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue_usd)::numeric, 2) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY d.season ORDER BY CASE d.season WHEN 'Winter' THEN 1 WHEN 'Spring' THEN 2 WHEN 'Summer' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

question: Which customer segments bring the most revenue?
ref_sql: SELECT f.customer_segment, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue_usd)::numeric, 2) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales f  WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY f.customer_segment ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC

question: Gross margin percentage per customer segment.
ref_sql: SELECT f.customer_segment, ROUND((100 * SUM(f.gross_profit_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(f.revenue_usd), 0))::numeric, 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM analytics.fact_sales f  WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY f.customer_segment ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC
source: Metabase card: Gross margin % by segment

question: What is the revenue per customer in each customer segment?
ref_sql: SELECT f.customer_segment, ROUND((SUM(f.revenue_usd) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_id), 0))::numeric, 2) AS revenue_per_customer_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales f  WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY f.customer_segment ORDER BY revenue_per_customer_usd DESC
source: Metabase card: Revenue per customer by segment

question: Break down revenue by sales channel.
ref_sql: SELECT f.channel, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue_usd)::numeric, 2) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics.fact_sales f  WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY f.channel ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC

question: For each customer segment, show customers, revenue, average NPS and average churn probability.
ref_sql: SELECT customer_segment, customers, revenue_usd, avg_nps, avg_churn_probability FROM analytics.sales_by_segment ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC
source: Metabase card: NPS and churn by segment

question: What share of all orders were cancelled, in percent?
ref_sql: SELECT ROUND((100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.order_status = 'Cancelled') / COUNT(*))::numeric, 2) AS cancellation_rate_pct FROM analytics.fact_sales f

question: What percentage of orders were refunded?
ref_sql: SELECT ROUND((100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.order_status = 'Refunded') / COUNT(*))::numeric, 2) AS refund_rate_pct FROM analytics.fact_sales f

question: What percentage of raw rows passed data validation?
ref_sql: SELECT valid_pct FROM analytics.quality_report

question: How many orders are there in each order status?
ref_sql: SELECT f.order_status, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_sales f GROUP BY f.order_status ORDER BY orders DESC

question: Show the data validation report: total, valid and rejected rows, valid %, duration and errors by rule.
ref_sql: SELECT total_rows, valid_rows, rejected_rows, valid_pct, duration_seconds, errors_by_rule FROM analytics.quality_report

question: Which country had the highest realised revenue in 2019?
ref_sql: SELECT f.country FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised AND d.year = 2019 GROUP BY f.country ORDER BY SUM(f.revenue_usd) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 3 products by gross profit in the EMEA region?
ref_sql: SELECT f.product FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_geography g ON g.country = f.country WHERE f.is_realised AND g.region = 'EMEA' GROUP BY f.product ORDER BY SUM(f.gross_profit_usd) DESC LIMIT 3

question: Show the monthly realised revenue of Product_D in 2020.
ref_sql: SELECT d.year_month, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue_usd)::numeric, 2) FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised AND d.year = 2020 AND f.product = 'Product_D' GROUP BY d.year_month

question: How many customers placed more than 5 completed orders?
ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT f.customer_id FROM analytics.fact_sales f WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY f.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) > 5) t

question: What is the average discount percentage by sales channel on completed orders?
ref_sql: SELECT f.channel, ROUND(AVG(f.discount_pct)::numeric, 2) FROM analytics.fact_sales f WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY f.channel

question: What share of 2023 realised revenue came from the Online channel, in percent?
ref_sql: SELECT ROUND((100 * SUM(f.revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE f.channel = 'Online') / SUM(f.revenue_usd))::numeric, 2) FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised AND d.year = 2023

question: Which customer segment has the highest cancellation rate (cancelled orders over all its orders)?
ref_sql: SELECT f.customer_segment FROM analytics.fact_sales f GROUP BY f.customer_segment ORDER BY AVG((f.order_status = 'Cancelled')::int) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average delivery time in days per region for completed orders?
ref_sql: SELECT g.region, ROUND(AVG(f.days_to_delivery)::numeric, 2) FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_geography g ON g.country = f.country WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY g.region

question: In which quarter of 2022 was realised revenue the highest?
ref_sql: SELECT d.quarter FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised AND d.year = 2022 GROUP BY d.quarter ORDER BY SUM(f.revenue_usd) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were returned (return flag set), per product?
ref_sql: SELECT f.product, COUNT(*) FROM analytics.fact_sales f WHERE f.return_flag GROUP BY f.product

question: What is the net profit by payment method for completed orders?
ref_sql: SELECT f.payment_method, ROUND(SUM(f.net_profit_usd)::numeric, 2) FROM analytics.fact_sales f WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY f.payment_method

question: Which industry generated the most realised revenue in Germany?
ref_sql: SELECT f.industry FROM analytics.fact_sales f WHERE f.is_realised AND f.country = 'Germany' GROUP BY f.industry ORDER BY SUM(f.revenue_usd) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers made completed purchases in at least 5 different years?
ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT f.customer_id FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY f.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.year) >= 5) t

question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires réalisé total en 2024 ?
ref_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.revenue_usd)::numeric, 2) FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised AND d.year = 2024

question: Combien de commandes ont été annulées au Japon ?
ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.fact_sales f WHERE f.order_status = 'Cancelled' AND f.country = 'Japan'

question: Quel produit a la meilleure marge brute en pourcentage ?
ref_sql: SELECT f.product FROM analytics.fact_sales f WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY f.product ORDER BY SUM(f.gross_profit_usd) / SUM(f.revenue_usd) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Donne le chiffre d'affaires par région pour 2016.
ref_sql: SELECT g.region, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue_usd)::numeric, 2) FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key JOIN analytics.dim_geography g ON g.country = f.country WHERE f.is_realised AND d.year = 2016 GROUP BY g.region

question: Which product ranked first by realised revenue in each year?
ref_sql: SELECT year, product FROM (SELECT d.year, f.product, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.year ORDER BY SUM(f.revenue_usd) DESC) rk FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY d.year, f.product) t WHERE rk = 1

question: Which year had the largest drop in realised revenue compared with the previous year?
ref_sql: SELECT year FROM (SELECT d.year, SUM(f.revenue_usd) - LAG(SUM(f.revenue_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY d.year) AS delta FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY d.year) t WHERE delta IS NOT NULL ORDER BY delta LIMIT 1

question: How many customers had completed orders in both 2023 and 2024?
ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT f.customer_id FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised AND d.year IN (2023, 2024) GROUP BY f.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.year) = 2) t

question: What percentage of customers with a completed order placed more than one completed order?
ref_sql: SELECT ROUND((100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n > 1) / COUNT(*))::numeric, 2) FROM (SELECT f.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) n FROM analytics.fact_sales f WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY f.customer_id) t

question: What was the growth in percent of realised revenue in Q1 2024 compared with Q1 2023?
ref_sql: SELECT ROUND((100 * (SUM(f.revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE d.year = 2024) / SUM(f.revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE d.year = 2023) - 1))::numeric, 2) FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised AND d.quarter = 1

question: For each customer segment, which sales channel brings the most realised revenue?
ref_sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (f.customer_segment) f.customer_segment, f.channel FROM analytics.fact_sales f WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY f.customer_segment, f.channel ORDER BY f.customer_segment, SUM(f.revenue_usd) DESC

question: What is the median value of a completed order?
ref_sql: SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v))::numeric, 2) FROM (SELECT SUM(f.revenue_usd) v FROM analytics.fact_sales f WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY f.order_id) t

question: What share of realised revenue was made on weekends, in percent?
ref_sql: SELECT ROUND((100 * SUM(f.revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE d.is_weekend) / SUM(f.revenue_usd))::numeric, 2) FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised

question: Which day of the week brings the most realised revenue?
ref_sql: SELECT d.day_name FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY d.day_name ORDER BY SUM(f.revenue_usd) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show the cumulative realised revenue by month for 2023.
ref_sql: SELECT d.year_month, ROUND((SUM(SUM(f.revenue_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY d.year_month))::numeric, 2) FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised AND d.year = 2023 GROUP BY d.year_month

question: In each country, what percentage of completed orders had a discount above 10 %?
ref_sql: SELECT f.country, ROUND((100.0 * AVG((f.discount_pct > 10)::int))::numeric, 2) FROM analytics.fact_sales f WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY f.country

question: How many customers placed their first completed order in 2020?
ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT f.customer_id, MIN(d.year) y FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE f.is_realised GROUP BY f.customer_id) t WHERE y = 2020

question: How many orders were placed in 2025?
ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE d.year = 2025

question: Quels sont les 3 pays avec le plus fort taux de remboursement (commandes remboursées sur toutes leurs commandes) ?
ref_sql: SELECT f.country FROM analytics.fact_sales f GROUP BY f.country ORDER BY AVG((f.order_status = 'Refunded')::int) DESC LIMIT 3
